crossRefs.note: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you…
If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh…
For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will…
I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word…

translations.web: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
translations.bsb: You know that it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.
translations.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
translations.asv: but ye know that because of an infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you the first time:
